description_for_human: Creates Azure DevOps bugs from natural language descriptions
description_for_model: Plugin for creating structured bugs in Azure DevOps. Use when users want to raise, create, report, or log bugs. The plugin analyzes bug descriptions using AI and creates properly formatted work items in Azure DevOps.

functions.name: createBug
functions.description: Analyzes a bug description using AI and creates a structured bug in Azure DevOps

description.description: The bug description or issue details provided by the user. Can include what went wrong, expected behavior, actual behavior, and reproduction steps.

context.description: Optional additional context or conversation history related to the bug

returns.description: Bug creation result with URL and details

reasoning.description: Creates a bug in Azure DevOps based on the user's description
instructions: Use this function when the user asks to raise, create, report, or log a bug
Extract the bug description from the user's message
Pass any additional context that might help with bug analysis

responding.description: Presents the created bug to the user
instructions: Show the bug title and severity
Provide the Azure DevOps URL for the user to review
Confirm the bug was created successfully
